content.value_statement: Creator facts can become inconsistent across campaigns and platforms. This skill queries and updates an append-only registry with provenance, authorization, and revision checks.
actual_capabilities: Query current creator records by pseudonymous aggregate ID.
Record rates, rights, exclusivity, compliance events, and performance baselines with sources and dates.
Review pending creator proposals in event offset order.
Accept or reject authorized proposals without deleting prior events.
Deduplicate creator handles using verified evidence or user confirmation.
Verify registry projections and report revisions, conflicts, and expiring terms.
limitations: Requires the shared registry runtime, schema, and catalog for canonical writes and projection generation.
Cannot score creator fit, judge compliance, review content, or choose partners.
Does not confirm identity from similar names or handles alone.
Requires user authorization before persistent writes and a lawful basis for personal data.

use_cases.title: Retrieve Prior Commercial Terms
use_cases.description: Review the latest accepted rate, rights, exclusivity, source, and date before a new negotiation.

use_cases.title: Resolve Pending Registry Proposals
use_cases.description: Compare proposals with current revisions, preserve conflicts, and record authorized acceptance or rejection decisions.

use_cases.title: Record Closed Campaign Results
use_cases.description: Add confirmed terms and outcome baselines with observation windows and provenance after a campaign closes.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Creator Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current rate, usage rights, exclusivity, and evidence dates for creator [aggregate ID]. Do not modify the registry.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner query for current accepted facts

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Fact Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a proposal for creator [ID] with [fact], [value], [source], and [date]. Ask before any persistent event.

prompt_templates.title: Review Pending Proposals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pending proposals for creator [ID] in offset order. Identify conflicts, missing evidence, and recommendations without changing canonical data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Proposal triage before an authorized decision

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile and Verify a Revision
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile creator [ID] at revision [revision] against [new evidence]. Preserve conflicts, explain adjudication, request authorization, append approved changes, then verify the projection.

output_examples.input: Review the pending exclusivity proposal for creator-7f42.
output_examples.output: The proposal conflicts with the current exclusivity end date. Recommendation: hold for clarification. No canonical event was written.

output_examples.input: Record the approved rate update and verify the creator projection.
output_examples.output: The authorized rate update was appended with an event ID and offset. Projection verification passed at the new revision.

best_practices: Use pseudonymous aggregate IDs and store only necessary collaboration facts.
Attach source, date, unit, and authorization to every proposed change.
Re-read stale revisions, preserve conflicts, and verify the projection after approved writes.
anti_patterns: Do not place raw contact details, credentials, or personal addresses in records.
Do not merge identities based only on similar names or handles.
Do not manually edit event streams or treat pending proposals as canonical facts.

faq.question: Can this skill score whether a creator is a good fit?
faq.answer: No. It stores verified facts and provenance. Use a dedicated fit-scoring skill for partner selection.

faq.question: Can it update the canonical registry in a standalone installation?
faq.answer: No. Standalone installations can prepare proposals but require the verified shared runtime for canonical writes and projections.

faq.question: How does it prevent duplicate creator identities?
faq.answer: It requires verified cross-links, contact evidence, or user confirmation. Similar names and handles are insufficient.

faq.question: Does it store creator contact details?
faq.answer: It minimizes personal data and excludes raw email, phone, postal addresses, credentials, and unnecessary personal history.

faq.question: What happens when two sources conflict?
faq.answer: It preserves both source events and records the adjudication rationale. Evidence is compared only for the same field, unit, and window.

faq.question: Does it require approval before writing data?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks before the first persistent event and requires explicit authorization for canonical changes.
